summary: CPU code scan to LOCATE the gold-gate 168x non-argmax SERVING-PATH bug (FR13_B1_SWE_GOLD_BIND: tree committer serves a non-argmax token at clear margin - p3 served Let 0.59% vs clean argmax ``` 98.88%; native TF==served 4/4 but tree TF!=served 3/4 = localized to the tree serving path). Per-forward GDN, h0 handoff, conv prior-window all CLOSED/bit-exact; full-attn within-floor. The carrier is the tree-verify SERVING PATH producing grossly-wrong logits at some nodes (168x = NOT a 1-ULP drift). Scan the committer/serving code vs native for the 3 named suspects: FIX-A bonus/self at accept-run ends, eager-pack replay row, conv-fusion committed-path at num_accepted>1. Locate the bug (file:line) + which suspect. NO GPU, NO implementation.

scan.servedTokenSelection:
EXACT path "verify-logits-row -> served token" for the greedy committer `_lumo_tree_path_lcp_max_greedy_sample` (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:5593). Inputs `parent_token_ids`/`self_token_ids` are precomputed argmaxes published at the call site (:7314-7316): `tree_token_ids[0] = target_logits.argmax(-1)` (parent-edge dist) and `tree_token_ids[1] = lumo_tree_self_logits.argmax(-1)` (node/self dist), passed in at :7236-7237. The row layout is built by the metadata builder (:7848-7853): `target_logits_indices[node] = sampled_start + parent_local` (parent's verify row, predicts node), `tree_self_logits_indices[node] = sampled_start + node_idx + 1` (node's own verify row, predicts node's children). The served sequence `row` per request is assembled at :5856-5882:

(1) ACCEPT-prefix positions p < best_lcp (:5857-5858): served = `drafts[node]` for node=best_path[p]. Accepted ONLY because `drafts[node] == parent_targets[node]` (LCP test :5811-5814), and `parent_targets[node] = argmax(target_logits[start+node])`. So served-accept-token == argmax(target_logits[start+node]) BY CONSTRUCTION. The gate maps this row at :5930-5932 (committed_row = start+node, logit_kind='target').

(2) REJECT correction, best_lcp < len(best_path) (:5860-5862): served = `parent_targets[best_path[best_lcp]]` = argmax(target_logits[start + reject_node]). target_logits[reject_node] = logits[parent(reject_node)'s row] = the last-accepted node's prediction-of-next = the correction. Gate row :5939-5943.

(3) BONUS self, full accept best_lcp==len & best_lcp>0 (FR13_TREE_BONUS_SELF baked ON, :5755/:5874-5876): served = `self_targets[best_path[best_lcp-1]]` = argmax(self_logits[start + accepted_leaf]) = argmax of the leaf's own next-token row. Gate row :5949-5957.

(4) ROOT correction, best_lcp==0 (:5878-5879): served = `parent_targets[best_path[0]]` = argmax(target_logits[root row]). Gate row :5944-5948.

In EVERY case the served token is the argmax of the SAME verify-logits row the gate re-reads (the published tensors `_FR13_CAG_TARGET_LOGITS`/`_FR13_CAG_SELF_LOGITS` at :7603-7604 are the EXACT post-constraint tensors the argmaxes were computed from, :7598-7600). Winner path selection is LCP-max over root-to-leaf paths (:5801-5826), tie-break earliest leaf (:5820-5826).
scan.whereNonArgmaxPossible:
Channel-1 (committed_token == argmax of the row the committer USED) is STRUCTURALLY TAUTOLOGICAL and can never fire a mismatch: the committer serves `tree_token_ids[k][node]` which IS `argmax(<that same logits tensor>[node])`, and the FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE row-stats (:5995-6003) recompute argmax of the same tensor (target_logits for kind 'target', self_logits for kind 'self'). _FR13_COMMIT_ARGMAX_GATE_STATS['ch1_mismatch'] is therefore expected 0. So the 168x serve is NOT a committer row-mapping bug.

The non-argmax serve is CHANNEL-2: the tree-verify-FORWARD logits row that the committer faithfully argmax'd is itself wrong versus a clean single-forward re-run. Evidence: gold_margin_reduce clean (research/fr13_workflows/gold_margin_reduce_wf_3c6f5c0a_clean.json forks[3]): tree served 'Let' (id 9764) is `served_token_tree_rank = 2` in the CLEAN teacher-forced TREE distribution; `tree_clean_argmax` = '```' (id 71093) at lp -0.0113 (98.88%); deviation_gap = 5.125 (168x); both backends agree clean argmax. The committer served argmax('Let') of OUR tree-verify row, but that row diverged from the clean re-run where '```' dominates 98.88%.

The fork is at a structural/template boundary (served_context_excerpt ends just after a closing ```bash fence + blank line; clean argmax = a new '```' fence at 98.88%, tree served 'Let' text). This is a bonus/correction position at the END of a deep accept run (num_accepted>1) at a code-fence boundary — exactly where the tree-verify forward's recurrent/conv state feeding that leaf/reject row is at risk.

Which of the 3 named suspects: (a) FIX-A/FR13_TREE_SAMPLE_ROW (:9552-9642) only rewrites `token_indices_to_sample` = the DRAFTER sample row for the NEXT step's proposals + the bonus-token's hidden-state pairing; a wrong row there makes the next-step DRAFTS wrong, but those drafts are then accept-gated (must match argmax(target_logits)) so they cannot be SERVED at clear margin. NOT the direct carrier of a served non-argmax. (b) FR13_EAGER_PACK (:5604-5708, :6099-6143, :6190-6217) and (c) FR13_CONV_COMMITTED_PATH (:1886-1897) both feed the COMMITTED recurrent/conv STATE that the NEXT step's verify forward consumes; if they read/write a wrong row at num_accepted>1, the NEXT step's `target_logits`/`self_logits` (= the rows the committer argmaxes) are wrong -> a faithful argmax serves a non-argmax-vs-clean. The conv-committed-path read_cols are NODE columns at num_accepted>1 (:1893-1896), the exact multi-accept regime of the 168x fork. THIS is the leading carrier; the conv-ab GPU wf tests it empirically.

NET: localize to the verify-forward logits at the served leaf/reject row at a multi-accept boundary (channel-2), driven by the committed-state handoff (conv-committed-path / eager-pack replay), NOT the committer's token selection (channel-1).
scan.vsNativeCommitter:
Native greedy committer = rejection_greedy_sample_kernel (/tmp/vllm_live_019/vllm/v1/sample/rejection_sampler.py:653-693). Per accepted position it STORES `target_argmax_id = argmax(target_logits[start+pos])` (:678-682), rejects on first `draft != target_argmax` (:683-685) storing that target_argmax as the correction; if ALL accepted appends `bonus_token_id` (:687-693). Native bonus = bonus_logits_indices row = `cu_num_sampled_tokens - 1` (rejection_sampler.py:631 builder at gpu_model_runner.py:2631) = the position-AFTER-the-leaf row = predicts the next token. Native target_logits_indices (gpu_model_runner.py:2640-2644) = one verify row per draft position predicting that position. bonus_logits = logits[bonus_logits_indices], sampled with predict_bonus_token=True (rejection_sampler.py:101-115).

ROW-MAP EQUIVALENCE (our greedy committer vs native, both bit-exact by construction): our accept-serve `drafts[node]==argmax(target_logits[node])` == native's stored `target_argmax[pos]`; our reject-correction argmax(target_logits[reject_node]=parent-of-reject row) == native's `target_argmax` at the reject position; our `tree_self_target` bonus argmax(self_logits[leaf]) == native's bonus from the position-after-leaf row (`cu_num_sampled_tokens-1`). Same logical rows, same argmax semantics. There is NO committer-logic (channel-1) divergence from native — confirmed by the structural tautology above AND by the probe asymmetry (native TF==served 4/4 in FR13_B1_SWE_GOLD_BIND.md:58-65).

THE DIVERGENCE IS UPSTREAM OF THE COMMITTER, in the tree-verify FORWARD that produces target_logits/self_logits: native runs ONE linear MTP-5 forward (FLASH_ATTN, 5 spine rows, shared linear recurrent rollforward), our path runs the TREE forward (TREE_ATTN, 9 caterpillar rows) and carries committed GDN/conv state across events via FR13_CONV_COMMITTED_PATH / FR13_EAGER_PACK replay. Native has no per-branch committed-state handoff and no node-column conv read; that handoff is the structural difference whose row/state errors at num_accepted>1 make OUR verify row wrong while the committer argmaxes it faithfully. (Note the temp>0 SAMPLED twin _lumo_tree_canonical_multidraft_sample at :6830 uses `_target_row = start+children[0]` and a no-children self-row branch at :6818-6827 — a DIFFERENT, children[0]-indexed map than the greedy path — but the gold gate is greedy so that path is not the carrier here.)

scan.fixABonusPath:
FIX-A bonus is NOT the 168x carrier. Two distinct "FIX-A" mechanisms exist; neither serves the p3 non-argmax:

(1) COMMITTER BONUS (FR13_TREE_BONUS_SELF, baked ON) at scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:5863-5879. When a path is FULLY accepted (best_lcp==len(best_path), best_lcp>0) the bonus = `tree_self_target` = self_targets[best_path[best_lcp-1]], indexed at self_logits[start + accepted_leaf] (CAG row map L5949-5957, logit_kind='self'). This is the CORRECT row for the winner path (the accepted leaf's own self-distribution). The legacy WRONG-row path `path0_native_bonus` (reuse vLLM's last-verify-row bonus_token_ids, L5869-5873) is gated OFF by default (FR13_TREE_BONUS_SELF=1); it would serve a wrong row for a tree winner not ending at the last node, but it is OFF and the 944-record gate confirms it never fired (channel_split_summary.json: all row_known=True, no bonus_native_lastrow). Native counterpart: vLLM samples bonus from logits[bonus_logits_indices]=LAST verify row, appended only at full-accept (/tmp/vllm_live_019/vllm/v1/sample/rejection_sampler.py:93,101-115 + kernel L688-692); that last-row equals the leaf row only for a LINEAR chain, which is exactly why our tree path must use tree_self_target instead.

(2) FIX-A1 = FR13_TREE_SAMPLE_ROW (L9514-9642) is the DRAFTER sample-row fix (which row the next-step drafter samples from), NOT the served-token selection of the current step; it cannot serve a current non-argmax committed token.

EMPIRICAL CLOSE: at every bonus record the served token == argmax(self_logits[the indexed row]) (CAG ch1_match=True; 76 bonus_self_spine + 58 bonus_self_leaf, 0 clear-margin ch1 violations; channel_split_summary.json). The p3 168x token (`Let`/9764) is NOT a bonus at all — it is node_type='reject_correction', bonus_source='reject_parent_target', committed_row=start+7, ch1_match=True (step 103 served_pos4, output/fr13_commit_argmax/channel_split_summary.json channel2_flip_records). So no wrong-row bonus served the 168x non-argmax; the committer faithfully served the verify-forward's own (wrong) row-7 argmax.
scan.eagerPackRow:
EAGER-PACK row-pack is CORRECT; it is NOT the 168x carrier. Eager-pack is a TRANSPORT/STATE-ADVANCE optimization, not a logits source:

(a) The served-token VALUES (parent/self/bonus target ids) are computed at scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:7314-7316: lumo_tree_token_ids[0]=target_logits.argmax(dim=-1), [1]=self_logits.argmax(dim=-1). Under eager-pack these are copy_'d into a persistent int32 buffer (_fr13_eager_pack_tree_ids_buf) instead of torch.stack (L7318-7325) — BIT-IDENTICAL values, only the cast/alloc path differs (the argmax inputs and token values are untouched).

(b) The committer DtoH pack (L5616-5708) collapses ~102 tiny readbacks into one packed copy. _ep_srcs order = [parents, drafts, ptgt, stgt, bonus, (counts), (flags)] (L5644-5654); the unpack walks the SAME order by per-source numel() offsets (parents L5677-5679, drafts L5680-5682, parent_targets L5683-5685, self_targets L5686-5688, bonus L5689-5691, counts L5692-5699, flags L5700-5708). Offsets align exactly; no row-pack shift. The 2D-bonus reshape [:,0] (L5622-5627) reproduces the legacy x[0]-per-row selection (L5714-5718). Same values, same rows.

(c) The eager-pack 2c output writes (L6099-6143) push the ALREADY-COMPUTED out_rows / accepted_rows to output buffers via packed copy — they do not select tokens. The all-layer replay launch (_ep_launch_all L6534-6553) advances the GDN SSM recurrent STATE for the NEXT forward (it does not produce this step's served logits).

EMPIRICAL CLOSE: CAG ch1_match was True at all 944 served positions except 10 exact zero-margin ties (verify_runnerup_id==committed_token_id, ch1_margin=0.0) — so the committer indexed the correct flat verify row at every clear-margin token, eager-pack ON. A row-pack offset would have produced clear-margin ch1 mismatches; there are zero (channel_split_summary.json: ch1_clear_margin_violations=0). For the p3 168x case the committed_row=start+7 and argmax(target_logits[start+7])==9764 (the served token), i.e. eager-pack delivered the right row's argmax.
scan.whichIsSuspect: NEITHER suspect 1 (FIX-A bonus) NOR suspect 2 (eager-pack row) is the 168x carrier. Both are CHANNEL-1 (committer row-mapping) candidates, and CHANNEL-1 is CLEAN: 0 clear-margin ch1 violations across 944 served records; the only 10 ch1 mismatches are exact zero-margin argmax ties (gate self-noise). The p3 168x flip is CHANNEL-2: the tree VERIFY FORWARD itself computed wrong logits at the deepest tree row. Specifically the p3 `Let` (9764) is step 103 served_pos4, node 7 (the depth-4/5 spine tail of best_path=[0,1,3,5,7]), node_type='reject_correction', committed_row=start+7, ch1_match=True — the committer faithfully served argmax(target_logits[start+7])=9764, but a clean teacher-forced single forward on the byte-identical prefix gives argmax=` ``` `(71093) at 98.88% while 9764/`Let` is rank-2 at -2.033 (output/fr13_commit_argmax/channel_split_summary.json + ch2_teacher_force_tree.json). 168x = a verify-forward logit divergence at the deep node-7 row, surfacing at code-fence/template boundaries. => The carrier is SUSPECT 3 (the verify-forward at num_accepted>1 deep rows): the conv-fusion committed-prior window (FR13_CONV_COMMITTED_PATH, patch :1894-1897 + fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:283-316 prepare_committed_path_conv_rows) feeding the GDN scan at the deep tail row, and/or TREE_ATTN deep-row ancestry-mask accumulation, corrupting node-7's hidden state -> lm-head logits. The running conv-ab GPU workflow tests exactly this. This is the front the OTHER scanner (suspect 3) and the per-layer logit ladder at flat row start+node7 should localize; the fix belongs there, not in FIX-A or eager-pack.

scan.convCommittedPathCorrect:
CORRECT on HEAD at num_accepted>1 — NOT the 168x carrier (suspect 3 EXCLUDED as a row/selection bug).

What it does: FR13_CONV_COMMITTED_PATH is baked ON (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:1431-1433 `_fr13_conv_committed_path = True`). It reads the PRIOR conv window for the current verify forward via prepare_committed_path_conv_rows (src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:283-316). At num_accepted>1 the read NODE column is `accepted_paths[b, lens-1]` — i.e. the committed-path LEAF node (fr13_tree_conv_fused.py:304-308: `path_cols = clamp(lens-1, 0, ...)`, `read_node_cols = accepted_paths.gather(1, path_cols)`), bank_rows = `spec_state_indices.gather(1, read_node_cols)` (line 315). This `lens-1` is exactly the prior-window column fix (3a9039cc read accepted_len-1 not accepted_len); it is CORRECT on HEAD. The snapshot is taken PRE-remap from the leaf's source row, which is never a remap destination (patch comment 1530-1532), so it is byte-identical to the legacy post-remap linear-column read for spine winners and branch-winner-valid for branches.

Where it feeds: the snapshot `_fr13_committed_prior_bank` -> `_fr10_prior_conv_state_bank` (patch 1894-1897) is index_selected per-REQUEST at patch 2193-2195 (`_fr10_prior_conv_state_bank[_fr10_b].index_select(...)`) and prepended as the conv1d source history to that request's x (patch 2205-2217). It is therefore a PER-REQUEST state shared by every node of the forward, NOT a per-node served-token selector. A wrong committed-row would corrupt ALL nodes of that request's logits diffusely (a CHANNEL-2 verify-forward state divergence), not yield a single-node clear-margin non-argmax serve.

Verification: byte-AB test (tests/test_fr13_tree_conv_fused_byte_ab.py:412-496, test_t4_prepared_rows_match_frozen_library) PASSES 8/8 on HEAD (ran CPU now): cols/rows/prior all torch.equal to legacy_gather_committed_path_conv_prior_reference across zero/len1/len//2/full accept for BOTH spine and branch paths, plus the non-monotone branch-winner [2,6,7,9] len4 case (lines 396-406), and the remap is whole-page int16-identical with inf-sentinel page-gap bleed detection (line 489-496). NATIVE has no counterpart: native chain MTP-5 has no node-indexed committed-path conv prior (the linear committer compacts by linear column only); this is an OUR-kernel tree construct.
scan.rowToServedMapping:
CORRECT — confirmed both by source re-derivation and by the in-process committer-argmax gate (944 records).

The committer _lumo_tree_path_lcp_max_greedy_sample (scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:5593) indexes the verify-forward rows as:
- accepted prefix pos p (< best_lcp): served token = drafts[best_path[p]] (patch 5857-5858), gate row = target_logits[start + best_path[p]] (5928-5933). `start` advances by node_count per request (5780,5097/6097), and target_logits was gathered via metadata.target_logits_indices which is BUILT IN NODE ORDER (patch 7848-7851: per `_node_idx`, row = `_sampled_start + _parent_local`), so target_logits row j = the PARENT-EDGE dist of node j. Accepted iff drafts[node]==parent_targets[node] (5812), and parent_targets = parent_token_ids = tree_token_ids[0] = target_logits.argmax (patch 7314), so served prefix token == argmax(target_logits[start+node]) BY CONSTRUCTION — channel-1 cannot mismatch.
- bonus/correction (pos == best_lcp): reject_parent_target -> target_logits[start+best_path[best_lcp]] (5861-5862, gate 5939-5943); root_parent_target -> target_logits[start+best_path[0]] (5878-5879, gate 5944-5948); tree_self_target -> self_logits[start+best_path[best_lcp-1]] (5875-5876, gate 5949-5952), where self_logits row = tree_self_logits_indices = `_sampled_start+_node_idx+1` (patch 7852) and self_targets = tree_token_ids[1] = lumo_tree_self_logits.argmax (patch 7315-7316), so the served bonus == argmax of the exact row indexed BY CONSTRUCTION.
- path0_native_bonus (the ONLY non-row-faithful path, vLLM last-row bonus, committed_row=-1) is GATED OFF on HEAD: it fires only when FR13_TREE_BONUS_SELF=0, but default is '1' (patch 5755-5756); under default ON the `else` tree_self_target branch is always taken (5874-5876).
